*One step from true inputs, the six evaluation simulations with 12–37 active sites pooled. Recall: the share of real births the model reproduces at the right site and frame. Precision: the share of its births that are real. Rollout ratio: predicted over reference nucleation events in 300-frame autoregressive rollouts, mean over site counts. Validation loss: the standard relative-$L^2$ loss over all five output frames, final epoch. Ranges are over training seeds. † Trained on the first output frame only, so it has no meaningful rollout and its five-frame validation loss is not comparable.*
